note: Which animals live in each country, authored by hand. Only animals actually found wild in that country — nothing is added automatically from the surrounding region, because the region can be right while the country is wrong. Names are titles from the Tiko media library; a name with no picture is reported by report-media-gaps.mjs and not shown on the globe. Set review.state to "verified" once a person has been through a country.
